Priya (Finance): Postmortem follow-up: need owners + dates for token-count remediation (backfill, invoice corrections, telemetry fixes). Short replies please.

Ashwin (Eng-ML): Ack. I will run the backfill and compute corrected token counts. Need raw ingress logs + tokenizer map. Plan: dry-run today, final CSV by tomorrow EOD.

Maya (Billing): I will own invoice adjustments and customer credits. I need Ashwin's CSV by Tue 17:00 PT to meet the billing cutoff.

Sam (Eng-SRE): I will own alerts and runbook updates. Adding ingestion-lag alert (>10m) and a pre-apply sanity check for per-customer deltas. PR by Tue COB.

Leo (Platform): Short-term mitigation: pin metering-api min-replicas=3 and introduce token-bucket backpressure. Observed autoscaler flapping at 2025-11-12T02:14Z. I'll open infra PR today.

LedgerBot: Ticket FI-6120 created: "Metering backfill + billing corrections" assigned to Maya (Billing).

Priya (Finance): Comms note: apologize, state credit, include appendix with calculation. I'll draft the template and loop Legal. Draft due Tue 09:00 PT.

Ashwin (Eng-ML): Logs exported to s3://redwood-metering/exports/1888881234-logs.tar.gz. Running dry-run: metering-backfill --from 2025-11-10 --to 2025-11-12 --dry-run --out deltas.csv. Will upload results when ready.

Sam (Eng-SRE): Proposed maintenance window Wed 00:30-01:30 UTC for apply. I'll be on-call and monitor tail latency and token deltas.

Maya (Billing): Preliminary estimate: ~$8.6k credit across two customers. Holding until Ashwin confirms final numbers.

Priya (Finance): Action summary for tracker: Ashwin = backfill + final counts (target Wed EOD), Sam = alerts/runbook (PR by Tue), Leo = infra PR (Mon midday), Maya = invoices + comms (Tue COB). I'll update the postmortem doc and notify execs after final numbers.

LedgerBot: Reminder set: FI-6120 check-in in 48h.

Priya (Finance): Thanks everyone — please ping here once your PRs are up and when the CSV is uploaded.
